recoveryAttempted.whatThatMeans: The refusal is issued by this session's GitHub access layer before the request reaches GitHub. The Captain's own check answering HTTP 200 is consistent with this: the Captain ran it from an environment where the source-artifacts repository is in scope. Repository scope is per-session, so a 200 there proves nothing about here.

remedyAttempted.note: add_repo is the remedy the 403 body itself names. It is not available to this worker, so the corpus cannot be brought into scope from inside the lane.
